subjects.label: Shooting and dunking
subjects.description: How shots and dunks play out on the court: the shot meter, release timing, whether scoring feels fair or impossible, and posterising an opponent; not the wider game systems or the modes.

subjects.label: Virtual currency and paying to progress
subjects.description: The in-game currency, buying your player's rating rather than earning it, and the casino-like design that steers every mode towards spending; not the base price of the game.

subjects.label: Career mode
subjects.description: The single-player career with a created player, its pre-NBA and dynasty stages, the tasks between games and whether the mode is worth playing; not online park play or the general grind.

subjects.label: Yearly edition versus earlier ones
subjects.description: Whether this year's release is a reskin of last year's, how it compares with earlier numbered entries and the old-generation version, and whether anything actually changed; not comparisons with other games.

subjects.label: Real players, cover athlete and ratings
subjects.description: The real players in the game: who was put on the cover, the rosters, favourite players, and whether a player's numeric rating matches how he plays; not whether the licence exists at all.

subjects.label: PC version versus console
subjects.description: Whether the PC release is treated as an equal to the console one: crossplay with console friends, getting the new-generation version, and the feeling that PC players are an afterthought; not raw performance on a given machine.

subjects.label: AI players and referees
subjects.description: The computer-controlled teammates and opponents and the officiating: stupid or inconsistent AI in offline modes and fouls the referees fail to call; not human opponents online.

subjects.label: Grinding your player's rating
subjects.description: Raising a created player's overall rating through play: how long the climb to the cap takes, daily limits on workouts, and the tedious tasks in between; not paying to skip it, which is the virtual currency row.
